title: Private reminder function-version configuration (names and constraints only)

REMINDERS_APPROVED.description: Set only after explicit resource, region, cost, IAM, enrollment/recovery, retention/logging, operator visibility and global Apple processing approval.

REMINDERS_BUCKET.description: Separate never-public Russia-region STANDARD bucket; no versioning, replication, object lock or reminder exports.

REMINDERS_OBJECT_KEY.description: Single fixed opaque aggregate key. Never reuse after closure/deletion.

REMINDERS_SCOPE.description: Opaque 32-byte family scope, not a diary family UUID and not an enrollment credential.

REMINDERS_ORIGIN.description: Exact approved HTTPS PWA origin, without path or trailing slash.

REMINDERS_POLICY.description: JSON serialization of policy below. All fields mandatory; there is no implicit approved retention policy.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Valid uncompressed P-256 application-server public key matching the dispatcher private key; safe to send to enrolled devices.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Dispatcher function only, provided through a separately approved protected channel. Never put a value in this file, source, arguments, diary, logs, backup or PWA.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: Dispatcher operator contact, mailto or HTTPS, approved before deployment.

REMINDERS_UNKNOWN_NO_RETRY_APPROVED.description: Dispatcher gate: explicit approval of possible missed signals rather than automatic retry of ambiguous external acceptance.
